_about: The numbers of docs/reference/FRAMING_RULES.md, for code to read. Not wired into the app yet. 'basis' says how solid each is: sourced (several web pages agree), ryan (his own ruling), derived (arithmetic), mine (unverified judgment, needs his eye on a real cut).

eye_line_fraction_from_top.basis: ryan (2026-10-21: upper third eye line is good); the band is derived

head_top_min_px.basis: derived from the top safe zone

safe_px.basis: sourced ranges (vendor blogs disagree: top 108-270, bottom 250-670, right 100-120, left 60-90); the conservative end is used

eye_line_fraction_from_top.basis: ryan (2026-10-21: upper third eye line is good); also sourced

move_inside_a_shot.value: never, except a smoothed path for a subject that really moves

frame_on.value: the subject of the clip: a person, action with hands, or an object

portrait.serves: Reels (one portrait crop for the vertical platforms)

scale_warn_pct.basis: derived (1 source pixel per output pixel)
